title: AFRODEUTSCHE
description: AFRODEUTSCHE is here from 6am to set a serene tone before the world wakes up, gently soundtracking your transition into the weekend.

title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Stuart Maconie presents a feast of great music and chat for weekend breakfast.

title: The Beth Ditto Show
description: Beth brightens up your Saturday with a healthy dose of tunes, laughs, and caffeine.

title: Jamz Supernova
description: Jamz is joined by Lenna Bahule, the Mozambican vocalist, composer and body percussionist whose music moves between Mozambique, Brazil and the wider Afro diaspora..

title: Gilles Peterson
description: Gilles plays music by GENA, Land of Echo, and Juan Atkins. Plus, an interview with Chicago vocalist Peven Everett and singer Georgia Anne Muldrow joins Gilles in the studio.

title: The Craig Charles Funk and Soul Show
description: The riposte, the comeback, the answer record.... that's what this week's Trunk of Funk is all about.

title: Don Letts' Culture Clash Radio
description: Don's Saturday night selections cross time, space and genre. This week, he's got new numbers by the likes of Renegade Soundwave, Sampa The Great, Shabazz Palaces and lavender.

title: SHERELLE
description: SHERELLE invites rising Swedish singer, songwriter and producer DJ Suzy into the Cab.

title: The Sweatbox
description: London-via-Los Angeles DJ and producer Carré brings her bass-heavy sound to the Sweatbox.

title: 6 Music's Rave Forever
description: Two seminal UK garage labels, Ice Cream Records and Nice 'N' Ripe, go head-to-head.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: Relax with this curated mix filled with the best music to come out of the USA, featuring Counting Crows, Lauryn Hill and The Doors.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: A hand-picked mix of chilled out gems to unwind to featuring Cleo Sol, The Strokes and DOPE LEMON.

title: AFRODEUTSCHE
description: It's one of Sunday's simple pleasures... Let AFRODEUTSCHE's selections gently smooth out the day with music perfect for peaceful introspection.

title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Stuart Maconie presents a feast of great music and chat for weekend breakfast.

title: Cerys Matthews
description: Cerys welcomes Grammy-nominated Malian musician Fatoumata Diawara to perform live and chats to legendary Indian singer Asha Puthli.

title: Marc Riley's Finest Hour
description: Marc Riley brings you a Finest Flower Tenuous Links special , where each song relates, somehow, to the last.

title: Jarvis Cocker
description: Jarvis dons a black bag to test the mere-exposure effect with author Luke Kennard, There's also a shout out to Trunk Records regarding their 30th anniversary.

title: Mary Anne Hobbs
description: Kali Malone selects a piece for the End of Days music library ahead of her new album Burning Song, and exclusive music from Blackhaine's upcoming release Saints in the Wethouse.

title: Stuart Maconie's Freak Zone
description: Stuart's featured album is American jazz guitar giant Sonny Sharrock's 1991 masterpiece Ask The Ages.

title: Dream Time
description: Zakia plays an eclectic mix of music to soundtrack your dreams, and Brazilian songwriting pioneer Joyce Moreno reflects on more than five decades in music.
